digest.component_or_area: completion verifier verdict banking and rendering
propositions: At BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE search exhaustion, verifier banks met=false as evidence-of-absence (false FAIL) instead of distinguishing exhausted-search from positive refutation
Fallback record path lacks a tri-state contract to carry evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met=false, preventing framework from distinguishing refutation from incomplete search
Ticket criteria satisfied in merged main fail verification only due to step budget exhaustion, not genuine criterion mismatch, creating anti-pattern pressure to misuse operator-attested tags
Completion verdict consumers (audit page, close gate, renderers) lack marker awareness and collapse insufficient-evidence FAILs into unmet-criteria output
Schema and banking persistence layer do not support optional evidence_sufficient marker on verdicts and criteria
